About me

I have been a student at Politeknik Caltex Riau since 2022, with hands-on experience in microcontrollers, control systems, embedded programming, and machine learning.

I completed an internship in the Engineering Department of PT Yokogawa Indonesia, performing instrumentation maintenance, calibration, and adjustment, both in-house and on-site at client locations.

I have led and contributed to many technical projects and competitions, from IoT systems to EEG signal classification.
